verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents only parts of the workflow. Employees upload receipts and memos through the mobile app (manual capture). Jeeves automatically emails employees when receipts or memos are missing, and card transactions trigger real-time webhooks that an integrator could build on. Nothing shows receipts being captured automatically at the moment of purchase, or transactions being auto-coded. Missing for 10: automatic receipt capture or matching at swipe time with no employee upload, automatic GL/category coding of card transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
